name: agrsearth-ai-assistant
description: AGRSEarth AI 助手独立能力包仓：@agrsearth/* 本地 workspace 共享包 + 独立构建/测试/发布工具

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agrsearth/vite-config && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run check:agents && npm run check:api-contract && npm run test:tools && npm run build -w @agrsearth/vite-config && npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:css && npm run test:s11
scripts.docs:html: mkdir -p docs/html && for f in docs/L*.md; do python3 tools/md-to-html.py "$f" "docs/html/$(basename "$f" .md).html"; done
